decision_basis: Existing question, retained immutable upstream code and prospective disclosed numerical choices. Geometry and header/table structure were checked without decoding BOLD signals. No original PR199 BOLD signal or endpoint values informed admission or threshold choices.

claim_scope.estimand: Signed short- and long-distance movie functional-connectivity Fisher-z means and their segregation difference; cross-sectional child age ranks with FD adjustment and participant bootstrap; full/restricted child/adult segregation Welch descriptives.
claim_scope.adaptation: Fair/Power-motivated movie-data methods and motion-sensitivity application, not replication of Fair's resting 210-person/34-ROI/four-network finding.
not_established: replication or refutation of the named paper

authority.source: Closed immutable original/coordinate/provenance inventory authenticated before any scientific parsing, with final reauthentication.
authority.canonical: Source geometry, 14-column confounds, FD, age/group, cleaning arithmetic and residual activity define support. Rounded submitted receipts cannot redefine these.
authority.accepted: Source-close cleaned ROI series are the sole downstream authority. Replay their own signed metrics, ranks, bootstrap and Welch values once.
authority.shared: The SHA-bound public reporting kernel is copied byte-identically into the private verifier. Generic header/table parsing and numerical libraries are shared; original decoding/extraction/cleaning routes are independently authored. No hidden reference endpoint, tie, p or sign gate.

source.subject_ids_rule: Literal sub-pixar001 through sub-pixar155 inclusive; sorted canonical order. No digit stripping or aliases.
source.headers_and_scaling: Preserve each original header and effective slope/intercept. Decode stored voxels to float64 then multiply slope and add intercept separately for each subject. No common scaling assumed.

spatial_unit_policy.authority: Pinned released processing README and Nilearn development description; record raw unknown unit fields separately. Power coordinates use their released operational MNI-mm convention, not a verified nonlinear registration.

source.clock: Use release-documented TR2 for the filter, not raw fourth zoom1 with unknown units. Retain all released frame indices; no measured movie-onset/slice-time alignment claim.
source.required_geometry: All264 sphere supports must be nonempty. No dropping or relocating coordinates to rescue support.
source.finite_policy: Require finite scaled BOLD at every voxel in the sphere-support union for every retained frame; unused voxels are not an admission gate. No contributing-signal imputation.
source.selection: All155, all released frames, all264 identities; no age/motion/outcome exclusions for primary analysis. FD<0.2 is a separate named sensitivity restriction.

software_reference.precision: Float64 scaling/means/cleaning with C-contiguous time-by-feature inputs. Float64 and activity are disclosed amendments, not bitwise promises for legacy dtype paths.
software_reference.equivalence: Agent library names/versions are descriptive, not an acceptance fingerprint; source-fidelity and numerical semantics govern.

roi_geometry.order: Retain literal original CSV row identifiers and row order; artifact permutations may be coherent.
roi_geometry.membership: Exact Nilearn0.12.1 physical-radius neighbors plus rounded nearest-voxel inclusion and integer-world-coordinate seed inclusion; overlap allowed, no smoothing or explicit mask.
roi_geometry.extraction: Float64 arithmetic mean of all selected voxels for each frame.
roi_geometry.support_digest: SHA256(b'DEVCONN_support_v2\n' + source shape3 little-endian int64 + selected affine4x4 C-order little-endian float64 with signed zeros normalized + ascending C-flat indices little-endian int64).
roi_geometry.interpretation_limit: Power operational MNI sphere mapping and derivative template alignment are assumptions; not independently verified anatomical registration.

confounds.excluded: FD is a separate source covariate, not part of the14-column cleaning nuisance design. No global-signal arm.

missingness.allowed_rows: Any original frame, with exact token/location ledger. This finite lexical allowlist is an explicit amendment to broad pandas fillna parsing.
missingness.invalid: Other nonnumeric tokens, NaN/Infinity spellings and nonfinite parsed values fail precondition, not implicit missing.

confounds.mean_fd: math.fsum(original finite FD or declared missing→0)/original T. Preserve observed count/sum, missing indices/tokens, zero-filled sum and denominator T; finite initial0 is observed. Source mean FD must be finite and nonnegative; there is no arbitrary upper bound.

temporal_cleaning.detrend: Demean and linear-detrend signals and confounds using pinned0.12.1 arithmetic.

filter.order_in_pipeline: After detrending both signal and confounds, before confound standardization and regression.
filter.precondition: Require actual SOS padding length to fit every sequence. No invented T>=30 shortcut.

temporal_cleaning.regression: Economic pivoted QR of standardized filtered confounds; retain abs(diagR)>100*eps64. Project with Y-(Q@Q.T)@Y.
temporal_cleaning.standardize: Sample zscore(ddof1), replace scale<eps64 by1; explicit activity rule before this step. Inactive columns zero.

activity.rule: Raw centered L2 positive and prestandardization postregression residual centered L2/raw centered L2>1e-12 using stable scaled arithmetic.
activity.canonical_inactive: Zero sentinel; admitted inactive tiny jitter ignored, never reactivated.
activity.support: Each participant's canonical-active mask defines eligible edges within fixed distance bins. Use all eligible edges, report exact nominal/used counts. Null empty family. No arbitrary coverage threshold.
activity.limit: Eligible-edge coverage may vary across people; this limits comparability and is not fixed-edge paper replication.

participant_connectivity.distance: Euclidean pdist in original coordinate order over all34716 unordered pairs.
participant_connectivity.bins: Linear quantile1/3,2/3 of all canonical pair distances; strict d<q1 and d>q2. Boundary ties and middle edges excluded, not rebalanced.
participant_connectivity.pearson: Stable centered normalized active ROI directions; C-float64 U.T@U. Correlation excursions<=1e-12 clipped to[-1,1], larger excursions numerical-failure null.
participant_connectivity.summary: math.fsum(atanh(clip(r,-.999,.999)))/n_used, in Fisher-z units. NO tanh; not mean-r or absolute-r.
participant_connectivity.segregation: Own unrounded short_range minus long_range; null if either family undefined.
participant_connectivity.bin_digest: SHA256(b'DEVCONN_distance_bins_v2\n' + b'\0'.join(UTF8 literal canonical ROI IDs) + b'\n' + complete i<j pair indices as C-order little-endian int64[E,2] + columnstack(short,long) as C-order uint8[E,2]); IDs cannot contain control characters.

child_inference.population: Exactly122 source-labelled children, sorted literal IDs
child_inference.ordinary: Average tied own connectivity ranks and canonical-age ranks; signed Pearson; conventional two-sided t approximation df=n-2.
child_inference.adjusted: D=[ones,average_rank(canonical FD)]; gesvd cutoff=max(D.shape)*eps64*smax yields rankq and df=n-q-1. Accurately center ranks, subtract basis@(basis.T@rank). Rank-residual activity>1e-12 relative to raw rank centered norm.
child_inference.continuous_fidelity: Canonical exactly constant child-family values give null despite accepted jitter; otherwise centered-relative L2<=1e-6 without absolute floor. Do NOT demand canonical ties/r/p/status.
child_inference.complete: No available-case primary group; any missing required participant metric gives complete-slot null with counts.
child_inference.perfect: Supported exact abs(r)=1 gives p0 for positive df; no epsilon denominator.

bootstrap.unit: Complete participant rows in sorted122 child IDs; same index matrix for all3metrics×2associations.
bootstrap.duplicates: Retain duplicates; rerank and recompute actual FDq and df on each draw.
bootstrap.source_conditioning: Apply canonical continuous constancy/fidelity independently in each resampled family. No hidden canonical rank correlation gate.
bootstrap.undefined: Keep all1000 slots with exact defined/status masks. Any undefined required slot makes that CI null with n_defined; no drop/redraw.
bootstrap.ci: Linear quantile[.025,.975] if and only if all1000 slots defined.
bootstrap.limit: Conditional on fixed preprocessing and atlas; does not propagate model/atlas or participant-dependence uncertainty.

group_descriptives.means: Equal-person complete child/adult means for each metric; exact constants valid. Null if required participant missing.
group_descriptives.welch: Full and strict canonical FD<0.2 child/adult segregation; not motion matching. Signed own child mean minus own adult mean;>=2 defined per group; sample variance, Welch-Satterthwaite df and two-sided t p.
group_descriptives.conditioning: For each full/restricted group independently, canonical nonconstant segregation requires centered-relative fidelity<=1e-6; canonical exact-constant group contributes variance0 despite admitted jitter. Means/difference always own accepted values, never canonical t/p gate.
group_descriptives.edge_cases: One variance0 with positive SE valid. SE0→null t/p/df with retained means/difference. Representation overflow/underflow explicit null, distinct from sourceconstant support.

exact: integer draw IDs/indices, nuisance ranks and rank-correlation degrees of freedom; Welch degrees of freedom are real-valued derived receipts
comparison.source_receipt_precision: Derived CSV six-decimal values are allowed within tolerance but are never reimported as inferential authority; source FD and metadata comparisons retain their stated precision.

pre_signal_evidence.structure_status: structural_issues; only unknown raw spatial/temporal units, resolved by separately disclosed released mm/TR2 convention
pre_signal_evidence.geometry_status: All 264 nonempty supports agree exactly between the separately authored routes; 6 to 12 voxels per sphere on the single released grid.
